g.text: 1. Each ejector stage 2 x 50 % parallel units; one shown. Motive MP steam.
2. Condensers E-202/203/204 drain via barometric legs (seal) to hotwell D-201.
3. C-201 top pressure PIC-2010 (transmitter on C-201 top, PFD-005) recycles off-gas to J-203 suction.
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
